Fiona (CS): Heads-up: SableMed renewal ~5 weeks out. Usage down ~60% last 30d, seats 16->6. Champion moved teams. Need quick triage and an outreach plan.

Rory (CSM): Any sign of a competitor trial or tech issue?

Fiona (CS): Procurement noted a 10-day eval with QuickEmbed starting this week. No error spikes from our side.

Mina (RevOps): Billing: embeddings -62%, gen tokens -44%. I can draft a short trial concession.

Alex (Eng): I'll prepare a compact bake-off harness (600-doc set) + reproducible metrics: precision@5, avg cosine gap, tail latency. Will push to /shared/sablemed.

Sam (Support): One support ticket asking for "cheaper embedding sample benchmarks". I replied asking for their sample dataset.

Rory (CSM): Plan: offer 10-day Dedicated-lite trial + bake-off session. If we win, offer enablement credit + pricing uplift. I'll own outreach.

probe-bot: Trial instance provisioned: sablemed-dedicated-01 (expires in 10 days).

Mina (RevOps): Drafting concession: 25% off embedding units for POC + $6k enablement credit on 12mo conversion. Will get finance sign-off.

Fiona (CS): Rory, invite new stakeholders (Head of Data, procurement). Alex, target to push bench artifacts by EOD. We'll reconvene after bake-off.
